newsitem.title: USA: Market Facts up after earnings reported.
newsitem.headline: Market Facts up after earnings reported.

text.p: Shares in Market Facts Inc rose to a 12-month high on Monday and a company executive credited the increase to its reported earnings rise.
Shares in the Arlington, Ill.-based market research company rose 5-1/2 to 35-1/2 in early afternoon trading. The previous record had been 30 and volume was 28,700 shares.
"We're delighted with the increase," said executive vice president Glenn Schmidt. "We were undervalued compared to other companies in our sector."

He told Reuters the rise probably was caused by a sharp increase in third quarter earnings, to $0.58 a share this year from $0.28 in 1995. The company reported the results in late October but it was only reported in The Wall Street Journal last week.
He said Monday's trade was largely from retail investors.
